posts.title: Our lives are defined by the patterns we see
posts.description: Our very lives are defined by the patterns we see. The patterns we see shape our reality. Thus, from a human perspective, it is not controversial to say “perception” is as much part of “what is” as Newtonian dynamics. posts.title: Intro to Archetypal Cosmology
posts.description: Archetypal Cosmology is the most important breakthrough of the 21st century, and as of yet relatively few people have heard of it.
